_doc: Grading (CAP-8). thresholds: minimum score (0-1, after the difficulty boost) for each German grade, best first; below the last one the grade is 5, or 6 only when score < sixBelow and effort < sixEffortBelow (basically nothing done). Gentle bonus: improvement >= improvementMin (score gain over the previous result in that subject) or effort >= effortMin (share of questions tried, hints used count as trying) each lift the grade by one step, at most maxBonus steps in total; the grade never gets worse than the base grade and never better than 1. difficultyBoost is added to the score per difficulty step above 3. Promotion: average of the Zeugnis grades (one per subject, the rounded subject average) at most maxAverage, and at most maxFives grades of 5 or worse (a 6 counts as a 5). comebackBonus is what a repeated year gives.
